gloss: to sink to the ground; to collapse

definitions.gloss: to sink to the ground; to slump down; to collapse
definitions.explanation: To sink down into a sitting position because one's legs give way, from exhaustion, shock, or sudden relief.

examples.english: I sank down right where I stood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧へたり{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To slump to the floor from exhaustion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦グラウンド→グラウンド：10813_guraundo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧へたり{込|こ}んでしまった。
examples.english: When the match ended, the players sank down onto the field.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive; there is no transitive counterpart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧へたり{込|こ}む (to sink down on the spot)
- ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧へたり{込|こ}む (to slump to the floor)
- ⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧へたり{込|こ}む (to sink down with relief)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{座|すわ}り{込|こ}む→座り込む：04641_suwarikomu⟧: to sit down and stay put (also a sit-in protest); へたり{込|こ}む adds that the legs gave way
- ⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to fall over; へたり{込|こ}む ends sitting, not lying
